context: The skill is `web cache serve` (a caching reverse proxy). Cross-origin assets are cached only when the CDN origin is named with --also, and the same --also and --cache must be used when replaying with --offline. Judge answer.md.

checklist.name: uses_web_cache_serve
checklist.description: Starts the proxy with `web cache serve` and a --cache directory, not by writing a custom proxy, wget/httrack, or a deleted script path.

checklist.name: also_cdn
checklist.description: Passes the image CDN with `--also https://images.northwind-cdn.net` so its images are cached and rewritten, explaining that otherwise cross-origin assets are not cached and need the network on replay.

checklist.name: warm_through_proxy
checklist.description: Fills the cache by opening pages in a browser through the proxy using the ?_origin=https://www.northwind-outdoor.com URL form (e.g. web browser open "$PROXY/?_origin=..."), visiting each page that must be cached, then closes the browser.

checklist.name: check_and_stop
checklist.description: Checks the fill with GET /__status (counts of cached files) and stops the proxy with GET /__stop or a signal.

checklist.name: offline_same_options
checklist.description: Replays with the same command plus --offline, reusing the same --cache directory and the same --also origin.

checklist.name: miss_is_504
checklist.description: States that a page that was not visited while filling returns HTTP 504 (cache miss) in offline mode instead of reaching the site.
